<a id="phase-US-03"></a>
### US-03

- **Phase ID:** US-03
- **Type:** user-story
- **Source UC:** UC-03
- **Title:** As the coordinator, I want a per-task agent that fills in one task's detail, so that a single task's generation failure never requires regenerating any other task
- **Commit type:** feat
- **Commit scope:** —
- **Commit subject:** implement US-03 per-task detail-generation agent

**Context:**

This phase creates the new per-task generation agent: a narrowly-scoped sonnet agent that
receives exactly one task's skeleton entry (from US-01's output) plus the relevant Tech-Spec
section and the compact full-skeleton task list (for duplicate-implementation awareness), and
returns only that task's detail block — verification commands and grouping rationale, restating
every structural field verbatim rather than re-deciding it (see Tech-Spec OQ-03). It is dispatched
once per task by `pm-phase2.js` (wired in US-04-TASK-BE-03); a failure or truncation on one
task's call never requires regenerating any other task's content — the entire reason this
feature exists.

**Tasks in this phase:**

- `US-03-TASK-INFRA-01` — create `gaia-generate-work-breakdown-task.md`

**Depends on phases:** none (independent of INFRA; no code dependency, only a design dependency on the Tech-Spec's per-task block format)
